milestones.title: Docker and database foundation
milestones.objective: Compose baseline for web/API/PostgreSQL/worker/Redis, first migrations, health probes and separate document/app-data mounts.
acceptance_criteria: Compose core starts without AI services
Database migration applies idempotently
Document root remains bind-mounted and portable
App health status distinguishes core from optional workers
milestones.notes: Done 2026-10-30. Evidence: `npm run check` (node checks, exit 0); `npm run check:api` (ruff clean, ruff format clean, mypy strict clean on 11 files, pytest 26 passed / 1 skipped in python:3.13-slim); `npm run test:compose` 9 passed (~3 min) against real Docker Compose 5.6.1 / Docker 29.9.2: fresh install without workers or AI, idempotent + concurrent migrations (one alembic row, instance_id unchanged), restart/down-up persistence with byte-identical bind-mounted library, total DB loss leaves documents intact, core failure -> 503 and recovery, optional redis/worker down -> degraded (HTTP 200), security posture (no published db/api ports, non-root, read-only rootfs, no password in logs). Bug found and fixed by the tests: unresolvable Redis host stalled /health ~8s (DNS ignores socket timeouts); optional probes now run under a 1.5s deadline. ADR-001 and ADR-002 accepted by owner; ADR-003 (Compose layout, named volume for Postgres, health semantics) was Proposed at M01 and later accepted by owner. Limitations: CI workflow extended but not executed on GitHub; the non-writable app-data unit test is skipped when run as root in the container; Docker verified on Windows/Docker Desktop only (Linux bind-mount ownership via FILECANOPY_UID/GID is documented, not tested); no Dramatiq jobs yet (heartbeat worker only); health endpoint unauthenticated until M02. CI verification 2026-10-31: GitHub Actions (Linux) passed on PR #1 and on main (check, check:api 72 passed/1 skipped, test:compose 10 passed), resolving the earlier 'CI not run on GitHub' and 'Windows-only Docker' limitations.

milestones.title: Local authentication and first administrator
milestones.objective: Secure first-admin bootstrap, email/password accounts, sessions, login/logout, access throttling, invitation and reset token primitives.
acceptance_criteria: No default admin credentials or open registration
Password hashes and secure session cookies used
Invitation/reset token tested as single-use and expiring
Admin user management API cannot read plaintext passwords
milestones.notes: Done 2026-10-30. Evidence: `npm run check` clean; `npm run check:api` in the pinned python:3.13-slim image: ruff and format clean, mypy strict clean (20 files), 72 passed / 1 skipped (includes the auth suite on in-memory SQLite: no default creds/registration, setup token hashed/one-shot/throttled, Argon2id, cookie flags, enumeration resistance, brute-force throttling per account+ip/account/ip with lockout refusing the correct password, session revocation on logout/password change/admin action, idle+absolute expiry, disabled-account cutoff, CSRF/Origin, invitation/reset single-use/expiry/purpose/replay/hashed at rest, admin authz negatives, no secrets in admin API or audit, 422 does not echo passwords); `npm run test:compose` 10 passed (~3.6 min) on Docker 29.9.2, including new test_auth_stack.py: migration 0002 on PostgreSQL, setup-token flow from the log, login/CSRF/Origin through nginx, invitation replay, logout revocation, throttling keyed on the real client IP forwarded by nginx, no password in logs. Opus 5.5 security review 2026-10-30: no findings at the >80%-confidence bar. Outstanding: ADR-012 Proposed awaiting owner approval. Known limits: lockout counting not strictly atomic under bursts; per-account lockout permits temporary victim lockout; no reset email (needs SMTP, later), no OIDC, no TOTP; health endpoint intentionally unauthenticated for probes. CI verification 2026-10-31: GitHub Actions (Linux) passed on PR #1 and on main (check, check:api 72 passed/1 skipped, test:compose 10 passed), resolving the earlier 'CI not run on GitHub' and 'Windows-only Docker' limitations.
